collections/sequence#

A role for collections with a size and items by index.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let names is Sequencing<string> = ["Ada", "Lin"];
let first = names.first();
let count = names.size();

Description#

A role for collections with a size and items by index.

let names is Sequencing<string> = Sorted(origin: raw);
names.size();
names.item(0);
names.first();
names.last();
for names -> name { … }

Arrays, Sorted, Repeated and many other collections play it, so code that needs indexed access can take any of them. The errors named below are the contract: an array played as a Sequencing throws them (indexing an array directly, values[i], stays a program error), and other implementations are expected to do the same.

Public API#

role Sequencing#

role Sequencing<T>

A collection with a size and an item at each index.

Sequencing.cursor#

cursor() is Cursor<T>

Walks the items in index order.

Sequencing.size#

size() is int

How many items.

Sequencing.item#

item(index is int) is T

The item at index, from 0; OutOfRange outside 0 to size() - 1.

Sequencing.first#

first() is T

The item at 0; EmptySequence when there is none.

Sequencing.last#

last() is T

The last item; EmptySequence when there is none.

enum EmptySequence#

first() or last() of an empty sequence.
